notes.title: Add manual and auto save functions, and improved the game's rendering effect
notes.content:
[h2]Add manual and auto save functions[/h2][p]The "Manual Save" function can be found in the main window Options > Backup. 
Click "New Save" at the top-right corner to create a backup save file with a screenshot for the current game.[/p][p]When you select a save file, you can view its corresponding game screenshot at the bottom. Click the "Load Save" button at the top-right corner to load this save file, which will overwrite the current game data.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545179/d3b48da1a904059c2ef028c67c90105273826ea4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The "Auto-save" function can be found in the main window  Options > Save. You can set whether to enable auto-save in the top-right corner, and select the auto-save interval as "Every hour" or "Every day". You can also set the maximum number of auto-saves.[/p][p]When you select a auto-save file, you can view its corresponding game screenshot at the bottom. Click the "Load Save" button at the top-right corner to load this save file, which will overwrite the current game data.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545179/42430fbc0d0748fbb8a35ddebe06640c18aee412.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Improved Game Graphics Rendering[/b][/h2][p]The current version now enables stylized rendering by default, significantly enhancing the overall visual experience. Additionally, anti-aliasing is set to medium level by default for smoother graphics.[/p][p]If you encounter issues such as a black screen, rendering artifacts, or wish to reduce system resource usage, you can disable stylized rendering and adjust the anti-aliasing level in the main menu under Options > Common.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545179/41d273a32dd03a4b181f32f95db78ad5ceb86694.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
